Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an unnecessary “exact-title” constraint on “The Time To Love,” dismissing valid candidates like “Time to Love” (1927/1965) and fixating on finding an exact match with “The.” This over-specification stalled progress and led to repetitive, unproductive searches. The Planner also failed to pivot despite having sufficient information that Amélie (2001) predates Beginners (2010), and did not systematically verify Beginners’ release date. This combination of overconstraining the title and not leveraging already clear data directly contributed to the failure to reach the correct (earlier) answer.
